code:
Text-only:    cheapest, fastest
Multimodal:   higher cost + latency
              (images: 100s-1000s tokens
               audio: 2-3 chained models)

But: text-only can't DO a genuinely
visual or audio task at all
caption: No universally 'better' option — only the one that fits what the task needs.

code:
"Summarize this UI mockup"
  -> layout IS the info -> send image

"Total on this receipt?"
  -> OCR once, reuse the text after

"Answer this typed question"
  -> no modality in input -> text-only
caption: Same question, three different answers, depending on what the task actually needs.
